mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Defender 110 P530 V8 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full rebuilt Land Rover Defender 110 P530 V8 engine typically costs between £8,000 and £12,000 for supply only. Reconditioned units start around £6,000, while used engines can be found from £3,500. Prices vary based on whether you choose supply-only or a full supply and fit service.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of supercharger or timing chain failure in a Land Rover Defender 110 P530 V8?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs include a distinct rattling or whining noise from the front of the engine bay during cold starts, which may indicate supercharger coupler wear. You might also experience coolant loss, overheating warnings, or rough idling due to timing chain tensioner wear.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Land Rover Defender 110 P530 V8?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, given the current premium vehicle market. A well-maintained Land Rover Defender 110 P530 V8 holds a value of £80,000 to £110,000+. Investing £8,000-£12,000 in a rebuilt engine with a 12-month warranty is financially viable and protects the appreciating asset value of this high-performance 4x4.

mainEntity.name: What is the engine code for the Land Rover Defender 110 P530 V8?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Land Rover Defender 110 P530 V8 is powered by a 5.0-litre supercharged V8 engine, derived from the proven AJ133 architecture. It produces 525-530hp and features advanced direct injection, a Roots-type supercharger, and sophisticated thermal management systems.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Land Rover Defender 110 P530 V8 engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service for a Land Rover Defender 110 P530 V8 typically takes 3 to 5 working days due to the complexity of the V8 installation and ancillary systems. This includes removal, thorough cleaning, installation, and comprehensive software calibration.

problems.h4: Supercharger Coupler & Timing Chain Wear - Why the Land Rover Defender 110 P530 V8 5.0L V8 SC Requires Specialist Care
problems.affectedModels: Land Rover Defender 110 P530 V8 (5.0L V8 SC, 2022-present)
problems.rootCause: The supercharger isolator coupler degrades over time, causing a distinct rattling noise on startup. Additionally, the timing chain tensioners can wear, and plastic coolant crossover pipes are prone to cracking under the high thermal loads of the V8.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supercharger coupler replacement, coolant crossover pipe upgrade, and timing chain inspection
repairOptions.longevity: Suitable for early-stage rattling without catastrophic chain stretch or overheating damage
